card.name: Inside drug brand names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of drug names, mostly brand names in capitals such as XELJANZ, OMCAZIO, VORANIGO and CIBINQO, and also docetaxel, when the name is split into parts and the rest of the name still follows.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: A middle piece such as AN, Z or IN inside an all-caps brand name repeated in dosing text.
modes.example: XELJANZ tablets 5 mg twice daily or XELJ<<AN>>Z XR 11 mg once daily
